# Handpoint Developer Documentation
# Fetch the acquirer URL for full implementation detail.
# Generated: 2026-09-17T16:55:45.835Z

## Acquirers
EPI | geography: US, Canada | sale(emv-sale+key-entry-sale+moto-sale+sale-and-tip+sale-and-tokenize), refund(card-present+moto-refund+key-entry-refund), reversal(reversal+remote-reversal), tip-adjustment, pre-auth(pre-auth-create+key-entry-pre-auth+pre-auth-capture+pre-auth-void), moto, tokenization(cygma), batching, pre-auth-capture-reversal, avs-for-moto, fee-mitigation | cards: VISA, MC, Discover | url: /acquirers/epi
PAYSAFE | geography: US & Canada | sale(emv-sale+key-entry-sale+moto-sale+sale-and-tip+sale-and-tokenize), refund(card-present+moto-refund), reversal(reversal+remote-reversal), tip-adjustment, pre-auth, moto, tokenization(paysafe-token+tokenex), batching, void, interac | cards: VISA, MC, AMEX, Discover, Interac | interac: true | url: /acquirers/paysafe
EmerchantPay | geography: EU | pre-auth-capture-reversal, sale(emv-sale+key-entry-sale+moto-sale+sale-and-tokenize+sale-and-tip), refund(card-present+moto-refund+key-entry-refund), reversal(reversal+remote-reversal), pre-auth(pre-auth-create+key-entry-pre-auth+pre-auth-capture+pre-auth-void), moto, tokenization(tokenex), money-remittance | cards: VISA, MC, AMEX, UnionPay | url: /acquirers/emerchantpay
Paystrax | geography: EU | pre-auth-capture-reversal, sale(emv-sale+key-entry-sale+moto-sale+sale-and-tokenize+sale-and-tip), refund(card-present+moto-refund+key-entry-refund), reversal(reversal+remote-reversal), pre-auth(pre-auth-create+key-entry-pre-auth+pre-auth-capture+pre-auth-void), moto, tokenization(tokenex) | cards: VISA, MC, AMEX, UnionPay | url: /acquirers/paystrax

## Integration paths
cloud-api | cloud/integrated mode | PAX terminal commanded via Handpoint Cloud API
android-pax | native on-terminal | PAX devices
android-hilite | bluetooth | HiLite (DATECS) devices
ios-hilite | bluetooth | HiLite (DATECS) devices
cordova | native SDK wrapper | PAX + HiLite devices

## Sale flavors
emv-sale | chip or contactless card-present sale
key-entry-sale | manual card number entry on PAX terminal screen
moto-sale | back-office remote sale using stored card token, no reader required
sale-and-tip | tip collected at terminal during sale
sale-and-tokenize | card tokenized during sale for future card-not-present charges

## Refund flavors
card-present | linked or unlinked refund with card present at terminal
moto-refund | back-office remote refund using original transaction GUID, no reader required

## Feature guides
pre-authorization-guide | pre-auth lifecycle: create, increase/decrease, capture, void, capture-reversal; hotel/rental/restaurant use cases; not supported on HiLite paths | /reference/pre-authorization-guide
tipping-guide | two tip strategies: sale-with-tip (tipConfiguration at terminal, all acquirers) vs tip-adjustment (post-sale back-office call, EPI+PAYSAFE only, must precede batch close) | /reference/tipping-guide
partial-approval | US-only; prepaid/debit partial-amount approvals; accept (fulfil at totalAmount) or reverse (use totalAmount not requestedAmount); /status timing trap; certification required | /reference/partial-approval
error-handling-guide | three error patterns (async poll, sync-flat, sync-nested); gateway errors vs acquirer pass-through; finStatus branching; display statusMessage as-is | /reference/error-handling-guide
transaction-recovery | transactionReference UUID links operation chains; terminal auto-retry loop (5s then exponential backoff); server-side polling; /status/all for net amount; HiLite not supported | /reference/transaction-recovery
avs | attach billing address (zip+street) to MOTO/remote-pre-auth for fraud reduction; EPI only; Android SDK + Cloud API; enabled per merchant by Handpoint | /reference/avs
multi-mid | route transactions to multiple sub-MIDs via externalId per request; one API key; Cloud API + Android PAX + iOS HiLite; not supported on Android HiLite, Windows, Cordova | /reference/multi-mid
fee-mitigation | four programs to recover card-acceptance cost: surcharge (credit only), dual pricing (all cards), cash discount, admin fee (all tenders); under development — confirm availability before building | /reference/fee-mitigation
money-remittance-guide | flag card-present sale as cross-border transfer (MCC 4829/6540); EmerchantPay only; MasterCard requires moneyRemittanceOptions (name+country); Visa is a normal sale with no extra fields | /reference/money-remittance-guide
moto-guide | card-not-present (phone/mail order): on-terminal keyed entry (EPI+EmerchantPay+Paystrax) or back-office remote card-token sale (EPI only); PAYSAFE not supported; must be enabled per merchant | /reference/moto-guide
glossary | definitions: acquirer, AVS, authorization code, batch, externalId, finStatus, MID, MOTO, pre-auth, tokenization, transactionReference, tip adjustment, surcharge, and more | /reference/glossary
receipt-compliance | EMV card-scheme receipt rules; required fields: totalAmount, AID (14 chars Visa/MC), TVR (10 chars), TSI (4 chars CHIP only), IAD, ARC, authorisationCode, RRN; declined txns included | /reference/receipt-compliance
terminal-reversals | terminal auto-cancels host-approved transactions; finStatus CANCELLED; messageReasonCode 4000 (generic) + specific cause code in customFields; not operator-triggered | /reference/terminal-reversals
